review: "Buy a meal and get a pie for $1" They want me to be excited for saving a couple cents. Also, pies are cheaper than a dollar when you buy 2. Who lobotomized the people that make the offers?

Worst app. charged my card for the meal but never placed the actual order. Support issued refund for the amount charged but never helped me place a new order that would actually get to the restaurant so it could be prepared and delivered. I'd give no stars if it were an option.
